scope: Independent Notch settings view; development Electron with isolated synthetic data

checks: Production shadcn bundle uses native data without preview fallback
Notch opacity applies natively without changing the floating assistant
Transcript insight trigger toggles from the Notch
Reading time saves from the Notch
Settings view withholds the display acknowledgement
Returning to content acknowledges the latest insight
Follow-up suggestions toggle from the Notch
Disabled follow-ups hide the suggestion controls
Notch settings renderer contains no runtime console errors

limitations: Opacity is set through the settings bridge in the native check; the slider drag itself was exercised only in the browser preview.
Physical OS click routing, the packaged app and meeting attendee-view exclusion were not tested.
